why: An undefined ${?x} next to one other value adds nothing: it becomes an empty string only "as part of a value concatenation with another string" (L636-637), "a single value is never converted to a string" (L376), and two undefined optionals make no field at all (L640-642), so what is left is the other value with its type, as typesafe/config reads it: [${?x}10, 1.50${?x}] is [10, 1.5].
